# Ankhimate — local pre-alpha context through T835 / T836 preparation

Unofficial Kr-Apo community fork; preserve upstream licenses/attributions. Public v0.2.0-alpha.1 was accepted/published in T812; RC2 remains a separate unchanged archive. This checkout is a local candidate, not a new release; internal version is not artifact identity. No inference/model package/publication authorized by cleanup.

Jade Sentinel is the only active user character. Technical synthetic and historical Crapaud fixtures remain solely for regression/evidence and are not in the local Windows test folder. Never invent the unsaved Qwen rig or a Jade PSD. Current candidate has native save/recovery/diagnostics, bounded rig transfer, FFD/Graph/PSD/weighted tools, numeric retime/selected offsets, owned FFD clipboard and saved clip ordering. Implementation is not universal manual/artist/model acceptance;444 manual instances remain pending.

Author schema1/envelope1/runtime v2/app0.2.0-alpha.1 are separate. PathPosition requires a recent editor; old readers reject it and current game export refuses it. Old editor resaves may change clip order. PixiJS/Phaser are external protected subset consumers; never infer all editor features are supported. No silent downgrade or hand-edited JSON workaround.
